insight: The largest signup cohort was 2024-09 with 903 customers.
Average signup-month retention is 93.1% across observed cohorts.
Average first-month revenue retention is 100.0% by definition; later periods show the relative revenue durability of each cohort.
At month index 34, average revenue retention is 77.4% across 3 observed cohorts.
2024-11 has the highest observed average customer retention at 98.6%.
Among cohorts with sufficient history, 2024-07 leads retention while 2022-01 has the weakest average retention.
